newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch central bank allocates fresh liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Dutch central bank allocates fresh liquidity.

text.p: The Dutch central bank said it allocated 5.81 billion guilders to the money market under a six-day special advances pact at an unchanged rate of 2.50 percent.
Individual banks' applications up to 5.00 billion guilders were met for 18.5 percent. Above that level no subscriptions were awarded.
The pact replaces a six-day facility of 3.28 billion guilders which expired today.
